Container.Name: plungarr
Container.Overview: Unclogs your Sonarr/Radarr download pipeline: auto-fixes stuck imports, removes dead usenet posts stalling SABnzbd, blocklists junk releases, flags chronic failures, and reports suspicious library files for manual inspection. What it can't fix safely it reports and leaves alone. Requires Sonarr and/or Radarr API keys; SABnzbd credentials are optional and enable the stall watcher.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: sonarr radarr sabnzbd queue stuck import stalled janitor
Container.Requires: Sonarr and/or Radarr reachable from this container with an API key. SABnzbd is optional.
Container.Changes: Optional leftover-folder sweep for SABnzbd's completed directory (LEFTOVER_DIRS, notify or delete). Orphaned downloads (series or movie deleted mid-download, NZB added by hand) are removed via ORPHAN_ACTION. Sonarr folder-name mismatches caused by parser quirks are imported with Sonarr's own mapping via FOLDER_MISMATCH_ACTION; possible real mislabels are reported. Matched-by-ID downloads with nothing left to import are cleared. Configurable actions for archive, dangerous-file, sample and not-an-upgrade blocks. Optional webhook notifications with daily/weekly/monthly digests.

Config.Name: Sonarr URL
Config.Description: Sonarr base URL. Leave empty to disable Sonarr handling.

Config.Name: Sonarr API key
Config.Description: Sonarr Settings > General > Security > API Key

Config.Name: Radarr URL
Config.Description: Radarr base URL. Leave empty to disable Radarr handling.

Config.Name: Radarr API key
Config.Description: Radarr Settings > General > Security > API Key

Config.Name: Sonarr 2 URL
Config.Description: Optional second Sonarr instance (e.g. anime). Leave empty if you have one Sonarr. For more instances add SONARR_3_URL etc. as extra variables.

Config.Name: Sonarr 2 API key
Config.Description: API key for the second Sonarr instance.

Config.Name: Sonarr 2 name
Config.Description: Label for the second Sonarr in logs and notifications, e.g. anime.

Config.Name: Radarr 2 URL
Config.Description: Optional second Radarr instance (e.g. 4K). Leave empty if you have one Radarr. For more instances add RADARR_3_URL etc. as extra variables.

Config.Name: Radarr 2 API key
Config.Description: API key for the second Radarr instance.

Config.Name: Radarr 2 name
Config.Description: Label for the second Radarr in logs and notifications, e.g. 4k.

Config.Name: SABnzbd URL
Config.Description: Optional. The stalled/dead-download watcher turns on only when both this and the API key are set.

Config.Name: SABnzbd API key
Config.Description: SABnzbd Config > General > API Key

Config.Name: Dry run
Config.Description: true = log intended actions without doing anything. Recommended for the first day.

Config.Name: Cycle seconds
Config.Description: Seconds between queue checks.

Config.Name: Archive action
Config.Description: Unextracted archive in a completed download: replace (remove, blocklist, search again), discard (remove, blocklist, no search), or notify (leave it, report it).

Config.Name: Dangerous file action
Config.Description: Dangerous or executable file in a download: replace, discard, or notify.

Config.Name: Sample action
Config.Description: File flagged as a sample: replace, discard, or notify. Default notify because short-form shows trip the sample detector on real episodes.

Config.Name: Not-an-upgrade action
Config.Description: Download that is not an upgrade for the existing library file, or a single-episode file that would replace a multi-episode file: replace, discard, or notify.

Config.Name: Folder mismatch action
Config.Description: Sonarr: episode numbers in the file name disagree with the release folder name (usually a parser quirk like 1x8_720.mkv). import uses Sonarr's own mapping when it covers exactly the grabbed episodes and the mismatch looks like a parser quirk (another season, or many episodes); a few same-season episodes is reported as a possible mislabel. Also takes replace, discard, or notify.

Config.Name: Orphan action
Config.Description: Completed or failed download that no configured Sonarr/Radarr grabbed, e.g. a series deleted while it was downloading. delete removes it from the queue and the download client (no blocklist, no search); notify only reports it. Set notify if you add NZBs by hand and import them yourself.

Config.Name: Notify URL
Config.Description: Optional webhook for digests: Discord/Slack webhook URL, ntfy topic URL, Gotify https://host/message, Apprise API notify URL, or your own endpoint. Empty = log only.

Config.Name: Notify format
Config.Description: discord, slack, ntfy, gotify, apprise, or json.

Config.Name: Notify token
Config.Description: Optional. Bearer token for ntfy/apprise/json, app token for gotify.

Config.Name: Notify extra JSON
Config.Description: Optional JSON object merged into every payload (Discord username, Gotify priority, Apprise urls). For ntfy the fields become headers.

Config.Name: Notify: attention
Config.Description: Items plungarr will not touch. immediate, daily, weekly, monthly, or none.

Config.Name: Notify: errors
Config.Description: API and cycle errors. immediate, daily, weekly, monthly, or none.

Config.Name: Notify: actions
Config.Description: Itemised list of everything plungarr did. immediate, daily, weekly, monthly, or none.

Config.Name: Notify: problems
Config.Description: Chronic grab failures from the failure review. immediate, daily, weekly, monthly, or none.

Config.Name: Notify: corruption
Config.Description: Suspect library files from the corruption sweep. immediate, daily, weekly, monthly, or none.

Config.Name: Notify: summary
Config.Description: Totals for the period with no per-item lines. daily, weekly, monthly, or none.

Config.Name: Notify: heartbeat
Config.Description: A 'plungarr alive' line even when nothing happened. daily, weekly, monthly, or none.

Config.Name: Digest hour
Config.Description: Hour (0-23, container local time; set TZ) for daily, weekly, and monthly digests.

Config.Name: Digest weekday
Config.Description: Weekday for weekly digests.

Config.Name: Digest day of month
Config.Description: Day (1-28) for monthly digests.

Config.Name: Reminder days
Config.Description: Re-send an attention item still unresolved after this many days. 0 = never.

Config.Name: Corruption report classes
Config.Description: Comma-separated suspect classes to report. Add tiny_readable and/or scanner_blind for the full list. Each suspect is reported once.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the service runs as; /state is chowned to it at start.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the service runs as.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Container timezone for digest scheduling, e.g. Europe/London or America/New_York.

Config.Name: State
Config.Description: Persists first-seen ages and loop guards across restarts.

Config.Name: Completed downloads
Config.Description: Optional. SABnzbd's completed folder (the one holding tv/, movies/, ...). Needed only for the leftover-folder sweep; set Leftover dirs too. Read-only is enough unless Leftover action is delete.

Config.Name: Leftover dirs
Config.Description: Container paths whose children are job folders, e.g. /downloads/tv,/downloads/movies. Empty keeps the leftover sweep off. SABnzbd never deletes completed job folders and an arr only cleans up its own, so folders nobody references pile up.

Config.Name: Leftover action
Config.Description: notify (report each unreferenced old folder in the digest) or delete (remove it; needs the path mapped read-write). Only direct children of the leftover dirs, never symlinks.

Config.Name: Leftover minimum age hours
Config.Description: A folder is a leftover only if neither it nor any file in it changed within this many hours.
